The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within each priority. `RegionManagerTest` and `SupportTicketTest` pass (5/5 each). I did not add a test for the example ordering.

The change is in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion`. I replaced the `ORDER BY t.opened_date, t.id` with the same `CASE` priority ordering that `listOpenSupportTicketsBySalesRep` already uses, and updated the Javadoc to match. The closed-ticket and region filters are unchanged. Nothing was committed.
